regressionEvidence.before: 0.6.0 failed a browser reproduction: first envelope received while UI was unarmed was discarded; zero requests.
after: keep first eligible in-window event until UI readiness
restore readiness even when that event has already been selected
duplicate frames do not create extra claims
no queued Open after Stop or window deadline

changes: separate received-event reservation from offering the event to native controls
keep transport health observable while navigation is blocked by a selected event
flush pending envelope immediately after UI readiness or reconnection
delivery report: state, queuedForReadiness, offeredAt and readinessWaitMs
preserved: one native UI flow, no direct API sender or ID prediction
at most two native Open clicks for first new envelope; optional second at 500ms; site lock respected
URL input and 120s manual login deadline
media reduction and limited reconnection attempts
installation: fresh ZIP extraction; npm ci --ignore-scripts, pinned playwright-core 1.63.0
privacy: Only generic source/artifacts published; no user reports, auth headers, cookies, tokens, signatures or response bodies.
limits: This change does not speed up upstream delivery of a notification that has not reached the browser.
No measured increase in real reward success rate is claimed.
